name: Sun The
overview: Scripture reveals that the sun is a divinely created greater light appointed to rule the day and to divide day from night, serving as a sign for seasons, days, and years, as seen in Genesis 1:14-17. The sun’s rising and setting mark the beginning and end of daily activities, exemplified by Lot entering Zoar at sunrise (Genesis 19:23) and Abraham rising early to meet the LORD (Genesis 19:27). Additionally, the sun’s presence is connected with both blessing and judgment, as God’s judgment on Sodom and Gomorrah occurred when the sun was risen (Genesis 19:24), illustrating its role in the unfolding of divine providence.
